story.title: Our Story
story.subtitle: Our Vision
paragraphs: Creme Cutz is a distinguished barbershop in Amherst, MA, dedicated to providing top-notch hair services for the community.
Run by UMass students, for UMass students. We believe in the power of a great haircut to boost your confidence and style.

team.title: Meet the Barbers
team.intro: At Creme Cutz, we believe in transforming haircuts into experiences. Our skilled barbers focus on precision and masterful techniques to craft hairstyles that reflect individual personalities.
